script: the heart wants what the heart wants

props.description: Two halves compete for the frame: left side shows cool-blue geometric nodes — a rational mind-map — slowly fragmenting into static noise; right side pulses with warm amber, a single heartbeat waveform rolling beneath. As the voiceover lands 'the heart wants what the heart wants', hand-lettered script sweeps diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, splitting both worlds, then the amber warmth floods the entire frame and holds.
